text: {"label": "Self-Injury Treatment, Restraint, and Punishment","definition": "Assessment and treatment of self-injury, often automatically maintained, including stimulus control, enriched environments, contingent shock and other punishment, restraint and arm splints, injury measurement, and wearable monitoring.","distinct_from_neighbours": "Unlike the broad self-injurious behavior reviews, it covers specific treatment procedures, restraint, punishment, and measuring injuries; unlike the brain injury and aggression topics, it concerns self-directed harm."}
